resume_instruction: Read README.md, run verify_literature.py, then execute round next_round. Append to SOURCES.csv; never renumber. Write ROUND_0N_FINDINGS.md; update this file; re-run the verifier; commit.

2.theme: Deepen the falsified-claim dossiers and close the Round 1 gaps
targets: Resolve LEAD-0001 (arXiv:2312.00137 authors) and LEAD-0002 (adaptive-delay Kuramoto authors); verify L. Arnold, Random Dynamical Systems (Springer 1998) and retire LEAD-0003.

Nonsmooth/active-set literature: Bouligand and lexicographic derivatives, piecewise-smooth dynamical systems (di Bernardo et al.), so REJ-SPEC-02 / S04 / CAVEAT-MS-8.4 have a full methodological chain.

Causality in dynamical systems: Granger / convergent cross mapping / transfer entropy, to test whether the D_bar paired-ablation metric is a defensible causal estimator or needs a formal identification argument.
Bootstrap specifics: wild cluster bootstrap (Cameron-Gelbach-Miller 2008, Webb 2013) to decide what EMP-AIEF13-01's 95% CI actually licenses.
Delay differential equation numerics: method of steps, discontinuity propagation, and the correct treatment of history at a split event (bears on AIEF_1_4_SPLIT_STATE_ABLATION).
Adaptive/plastic delay networks beyond the two 2026 preprints; state-dependent delay theory (Hartung, Turi, Walther).
Resonance and frequency selection in delay-coupled oscillator networks (bears on AIEF_1_3 and the T_window programme).
Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of linear algebra and matrix rank, to state LEAN-CF-01 at the right level of generality (rank-incidence theorem, not a one-off kernel computation).
Reproducibility standards: ACM badging, RRPR, and the provenance model needed for the Stage 7 CI gates.
Numerical reproducibility of transcendental functions across libm implementations, to justify the two-tier tolerance gate.

5.theme: Topology of evolving networks and competing metrics
targets: Persistent homology / topological persistence as an alternative to thresholded-graph D_bar.
Motif and null-model standards beyond Milo 2002 (degree-preserving rewiring, significance thresholds) to restate or retire REJ-K3-04.
Network intervention and knockout methodology, to compare the ablation design against the literature standard.

known_gaps: All Round 1 retrievals are metadata- or abstract-level. No paywalled full text was opened. Theorem-level claims attributed to a source are stated as that source's abstract position unless a numbered theorem was read.
No forward-citation or citation-graph analysis was performed; the field map is search-driven and therefore recall-limited.

The repository cites no external literature anywhere in its 2,760-file tree (checked: the manuscript and audits argue from first principles and internal evidence only). Round 1 is therefore the first external bibliography in the project, not a completion of an existing one.
Round 1 did not read the code of AIEF_1_3_paired_statistics_updated.py closely enough to confirm which bootstrap variant its 95% interval uses; flagged in SOURCES notes for round 2.
